title: Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box
subtitle: A mystery boards the train
summary: Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box is Level-5's second Nintendo DS puzzle adventure starring Hershel Layton and Luke. A box said to kill whoever opens it sends them on a railway journey through several locations. Known as Pandora's Box in Europe, the game expands the first adventure's village-sized investigation into a trip with changing destinations. Residents still offer brainteasers in exchange for attention or assistance. The journey supplies a larger mystery, while each conversation can pause it for a smaller problem to consider at leisure.
body: Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box is Level-5's second Nintendo DS puzzle adventure starring Hershel Layton and Luke. A box said to kill whoever opens it sends them on a railway journey through several locations. Known as Pandora's Box in Europe, the game expands the first adventure's village-sized investigation into a trip with changing destinations. Residents still offer brainteasers in exchange for attention or assistance. The journey supplies a larger mystery, while each conversation can pause it for a smaller problem to consider at leisure.

Puzzles use the stylus to enter numbers, select an answer, mark a location or rearrange pieces. Their picarat values reward a correct solution, with the first wrong attempts reducing the points available. Hint coins found around the locations can buy assistance, allowing progress without imposing a time limit on thought. The familiar system makes a new destination immediately approachable. A scene can contain a clue, a conversation and a hidden coin, so looking around remains useful even before the next puzzle has appeared on screen.

Puzzle rewards feed three smaller activities: exercising a hamster, repairing a camera and collecting ingredients for tea. Brewing and serving a suitable cup gives the people encountered another reason to matter beyond their next riddle. The camera and hamster similarly turn progress into objects the player can revisit between chapters. These diversions give the railway mystery a relaxed domestic texture. A dangerous rumour may be driving the investigation, but Layton's travelling routine still has room for a drink, a repair and another patient attempt at a puzzle.
story_headings: Reasoning in the palm of a hand
